items.title: Introduction to R for Data Science

source_refs.note: 'Introduction to R for Data Science' under topic 6.10, as printed (PDF 89, printed 85).

blocks.text: R is a programming language for data analysis that is widely used in research. It provides strong graphical tools to visualize data. R handles large datasets efficiently. Many packages support data science tasks. Learning R improves analytical skills that support machine learning basics.
